title: Consensus Timewalk
tagline: Compare how different distributed agreement strategies trade message complexity against finality latency under network churn.

curves.label: Chained HotStuff
curves.code: function hotstuff(n){return 0.03*n*Math.log2(n)+0.6*Math.log2(n);} // leader pipeline + quorum certificate propagation
curves.name: Chained HotStuff

curves.label: Raft Quorum Replication
curves.code: function raft(n){return 0.06*n+1.4*Math.log2(n);} // sequential replication + election backoff overhead
curves.name: Raft Quorum Replication

curves.label: Multi-Phase BFT
curves.code: function bft(n){return 0.08*n*n+2.2*n;} // O(n^2) all-to-all voting per phase plus retransmissions
curves.name: Multi-Phase BFT

curves.label: Gossip-Then-Fast-Finalize
curves.code: function gossip(n){return 0.02*n*Math.log2(n)+0.25*n;} // epidemic dissemination amortized with short fast path
curves.name: Gossip-Then-Fast-Finalize

curves.label: Centralized Witnessing
curves.code: function witness(n){return 0.5*n;} // single coordinator bottleneck: linear fan-in dominates latency
curves.name: Centralized Witnessing
